thread:
anish: Quick sync — customer ACME asked to ramp 'smart-routing' in EU but wants a conservative canary + explicit gating. Can we sketch a plan?
rachel: What do they consider the minimal safe launch scope? Need clear rollout windows and rollback criteria.
miguel: Proposal: 2% EU traffic -> 10% -> 50% over staged days with metric gates at each step. Also shadowing for opt-in customers.
elaine: We should simulate prefix cache pressure and KV cache churn during the canary. devex, can you run that against eu region profile?
devex: Yep. I have a harness. Example run: `./simulate_load --region eu --seq-distrib heavy --kv-churn 0.15`. I'll post results.
sam: Gate thresholds suggestion: p50 latency < 120ms, p95 < 300ms, error rate < 0.2% sustained over 10m windows, and cost delta < 30% vs baseline.
rachel: Add a quality gate: per-customer eval set — if embedding/accuracy drops > 2 points we stop the ramp. PMs to provide eval sets.
miguel: Fallback policy: automatic fallback to baseline model variant for failing requests + route to another region if EU capacity spikes. Need tenant-level kill-switch.
anish: Kill-switch options: tenant flag, global circuit-breaker, and an emergency traffic-shift script ops can run. Which do we want by launch?
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy queued: smart-routing v3 -> eu-canary pool (initial 2%) — ETA tomorrow 09:00 UTC.
elaine: Ops: can we run a 1h shadow run today for 3 consenting tenants? That would catch regressions before canary.
devex: I can enable shadowing for 5 tenants. Need their tenant IDs + sign-off. I will collect eval traces and a small quality report.
rachel: @devex please add an automated eval job that runs nightly: `pytest -k quality_checks --region=eu` and post summary to #product.
sam: Rollback ladder idea: at 2% breach -> freeze and alert, at 10% breach -> auto-rollback if metric gate fails for 3 consecutive 10m windows, at 50% breach -> immediate rollback.
miguel: I'll add extra traces and span tags around routing decisions so we can slice latency by tenant and route.
anish: Next steps: devex runs sim by EOD, ops to stage canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC, PMs to confirm customer consent and provide eval sets. If no objections by 16:00 UTC we proceed.
rachel: No objections from me. +1 :thumbsup:
elaine: Fine on my end. Will watch the sim results.
sam: Acknowledged. I'll set up alerting dashboards and the rollback webhook.
devex: Starting sim now, will drop logs and a short summary into this thread when done.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Reminder — ensure runbook updated: `/runbooks/smart-routing-canary.md` before canary start.
